fde-sdlc-business-requirement/lab-1-disc.summary: Tutored lab: discovery questions + BRD for the **Todo** app (practice before Ask IT).

sections.heading: Read vs lab vs assignment
sections.body: Reads above teach **Ask IT** discovery ideas. **This lab** writes discovery + BRD for **Todo** with your tutor. **Assignment:** *One-page BRD and discovery questions* — same work for **Ask IT**, alone.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: discovery.md (12 questions) and Todo BRD.md with all required headings. Tutor signed off checkpoints in the lab panel.

fde-sdlc-business-requirement/one-page-b.summary: Assignment: Ask IT discovery + BRD—on your own, using Todo lab notes.

sections.heading: Before you start
sections.body: Finish **Lab 1: Todo discovery and BRD** with your tutor. Copy the structure, not the Todo feature text. Expand the **Assignment** panel at the bottom of this page for Ask IT prompts.
